question: Estimate the annual revenue of BookMyShow in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: All verticals: movie ticketing + live events + sports + theatre? Yes.
Net revenue (commission income) or GMV (ticket value)? Provide both, primary = net revenue.
Includes BookMyShow Stream + non-ticketing revenue? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Movie ticketing GMV: ~12 crore tickets/year sold via BMS × avg ₹250 = ~₹3,000 Cr GMV.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus on-platform advertising (banners, sponsored slots): ~₹150 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~12 crore tickets/year sold via BMS × avg ₹250 = ~₹3,000 Cr GMV.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Live events ticketing (concerts, comedy, IPL, music)
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~3-4 crore tickets × avg ₹1,500 = ~₹5,000 Cr GMV (Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, IPL pumped this up).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Take rate (convenience fee + ad revenue + brand activation)

calculationFlow: Movie ticketing GMV: ~12 crore tickets/year sold via BMS × avg ₹250 = ~₹3,000 Cr GMV.
Live events ticketing (concerts, comedy, IPL, music): ~3-4 crore tickets × avg ₹1,500 = ~₹5,000 Cr GMV (Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, IPL pumped this up).
Sports + theatre + smaller events: ~₹500 Cr GMV.
Take rate (convenience fee + ad revenue + brand activation): ~8-12% blended.
Plus on-platform advertising (banners, sponsored slots): ~₹150 Cr.
Plus enterprise/B2B (Showcase + ticketing tech licensing): ~₹50 Cr.
